gloss: at this very moment; just about to

definitions.gloss: at this very moment; right now
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is happening precisely at the present moment. Stronger and more dramatic than 今 alone.

definitions.gloss: just about to; on the verge of
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is on the brink of happening. Often used with ～ようとしている or ～するところ to express imminent action.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まさに⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}する→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm just about to leave right now.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まさに⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まろう→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting is just about to begin.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まさに⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{転換期|てんかんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えている→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The world is at this very moment entering a major turning point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{今|いま}まさに⟦{沈|しず}もう→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The sun was just about to set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今|いま}まさに⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られている→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: He is at this very moment being forced to make the most important decision of his life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{今|いま}まさに⟦{上陸|じょうりく}→上陸：20591_jouriku⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The storm is just about to make landfall.

notes:
USAGE:
Combines ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ (now) with ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧ (precisely, exactly) for strong temporal emphasis. Often appears in news reports and dramatic narration. The expression highlights urgency or the critical nature of the present moment.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今|いま}まさに～よう⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is just about to ~)
- {今|いま}まさに～⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧だ (is right in the middle of ~)
- {今|いま}まさに～⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ (is doing ~ at this very moment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧: just now — neutral timing, less dramatic than {今|いま}まさに
- ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧: precisely, exactly — can be used without ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧ for non-temporal emphasis
